about_the_game:
Adventure is waiting!

Dive into the very center of the Rift and carve your way through your enemies, forming a team of elementals while collecting upgrades. Outsmart your opponents by employing surprising attack sequences and precisely synchronized strikes to reveal the secrets of this mysterious place.

Defeat Powerful Bosses

In the demo version of Primal Fray, you will face two powerful enemies: Elder Hortensius and the ice dragoness, Lady Maestitia. Will you be able to outsmart them? Or perhaps you'll build the perfect team to defeat them? The possibilities are endless, but one thing is for sure... it won't be easy.

Choose Your Way

You will have to make tough decisions whether to add a new elemental to your team, acquire a spell, heal your team, earn currency, or visit a merchant. Plan your journey through the Rift and make the most of every opportunity.

Visit new bioms

In the demo version, you'll discover three distinct biomes: the Ancient Grove, the Valley of Despair, and the Ironclad Training Facility each featuring different elementals and unique environments.

Local PvP

Demo Primal Fray offers a local PvP mode in hot seat, where two players can engage in strategic, turn-based battles on custom maps using the teams selected during the draft.

Primal Fray

Demo Primal Fray is only the beginning of the adventure! Immerse yourself in an epic journey filled with battles, bosses, and challenges. Forge your way through the Rift and be the first to uncover all its secrets! Visit Primal Fray on Steam and add the game to your wishlist today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MSI GeForce GTX950 2048MB 128bit Gaming
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: *Since 1 January 2024, the Steam client no longer runs on anything below Windows 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Gigabyte Radeon R7 360 2048MB 128bit OC
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Primal Fray demo is a turn-based strategy roguelite. Enter the Rift and fight your way through enemies while building a team of primals and collecting buffs along the way. Outmaneuver your foes and surprise them with powerful combos of a well-built team to learn the truth about the Rift.
